name: Nakamori Shouta
source:
Tsubame's husband, Setsuka's father. He has known Inaho Shin since his high school days. Despite not being home much because of work, he cares deeply about his wife and daughter. What happened between him and Tsubame in the past?
[translated from official website character bio]
